verdict.rationale: Rev AI documents automatic punctuation and inverse text normalization (number formatting) on all processed audio, and the marketing page promises proper grammar, punctuation, and formatting, so the core output-formatting half of the story is covered. Nothing shows a way to disable formatting: the docs say it applies to "all audio processed," the disfluency setting is a different control, and the plaintext output is a different format rather than unformatted text. missing for 10: a documented option to turn punctuation/ITN formatting off, explicit evidence of casing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
